id.description: The ID of the [subscription item](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions/object#subscription_object-items-data-id) to be updated.

price.description: The price the customer should subscribe to through this flow. The price must also be included in the configuration's [`features.subscription_update.products`](https://docs.stripe.com/api/customer_portal/configuration#portal_configuration_object-features-subscription_update-products).

quantity.description: [Quantity](https://docs.stripe.com/subscriptions/quantities) for this item that the customer should subscribe to through this flow.
